sloka: यत्तदा दण्डकारण्ये पितरं हतवान् मम।मदग्रतः स्वकर्मस्थं दृष्ट्वा रोषो ऽभिवर्धते ।। ६.७९.११ ।।
transliteration: yattadā daṇḍakāraṇye pitaraṁ hatavān mama।madagrataḥ svakarmasthaṁ dṛṣṭvā roṣo 'bhivardhate ।। 6.79.11 ।।

translations.english: "Then in Dandakaranya my father was killed. Now for the samereason you are in front of me. Seeing you my anger is increasing."
